hidden_homeroom_d2_low.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d2_low.text: *At the teachers' office door, you run into your homeroom teacher. She turns the papers in her hand back toward her desk.* Let's not talk one-on-one today. I'll see you in class.

hidden_homeroom_d2_neg.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d2_neg.text: *She turns the papers toward her chest.* Nothing to discuss today. Go to class.

morning2_start.name: {name}
morning2_start.text: *Day two. The creases in my uniform sleeves are fainter than yesterday.*

morning2_greet_seo_1_roof.name: Seoyeon
morning2_greet_seo_1_roof.text: What you said on the roof yesterday — still stands?

morning2_greet_seo_2.name: Seoyeon
morning2_greet_seo_2.text: You're early. Finding your classroom okay now? *Dain pushes her chair back; Yuna turns a page.*

morning2_greet_dain_2.name: Dain
morning2_greet_dain_2.text: Still half asleep? Look this way. I don't want to say good morning to your back. *She claps my shoulder from behind.*

morning2_greet_dain_others.name: {name}
morning2_greet_dain_others.text: Dain, you'll wear me out before homeroom. Just hearing you feels like being out on the sports field already. *Seoyeon passes, turning a page on her clipboard.*

morning2_greet_dain_others_yuna.name: {name}
morning2_greet_dain_others_yuna.text: *The tip of Yuna's pen leaves a dot of ink in the middle of her note.*

morning2_greet_dain_others_2.name: {name}
morning2_greet_dain_others_2.text: *After the classroom door closes, a single tap of a clipboard sounds from the hall.*

morning2_greet_yuna_2.name: {name}
morning2_greet_yuna_2.text: *Yuna's handwriting. One sentence longer than yesterday. — On the back, in tiny letters: 'Library annex at lunch.'*

morning2_greet_yuna_others.name: Seoyeon
morning2_greet_yuna_others.text: A letter this early in the morning?

morning2_greet_yuna_others_seo.name: Seoyeon
morning2_greet_yuna_others_seo.text: Am I not allowed to see that note? *She points at its edge.*

morning2_greet_yuna_others_2.name: {name}
morning2_greet_yuna_others_2.text: *I fold the note and hold it in my hand, pressing down the crease inside my palm.*

morning2_dain_1.name: {name}
morning2_dain_1.text: *The moment I open the classroom door, a palm smacks me between the shoulder blades.*

morning2_dain_3.name: Dain
morning2_dain_3.text: Startled you? Just getting you awake!

morning2_dain_4.name: {name}
morning2_dain_4.text: Isn't it a little early for this much energy?

morning2_dain_5.name: Dain
morning2_dain_5.text: This IS normal! You're the one running on empty!

morning2_dain_6.name: {name}
morning2_dain_6.text: Fine, I'm short on energy. Then share some with me. Just don't try to shout it into me. *Dain's voice rings through the classroom before homeroom.*

morning2_yuna_seen.name: Yuna
morning2_yuna_seen.text: ...Had you ever been here before you transferred?

morning2_note_1.name: {name}
morning2_note_1.text: *I'm about to sit down when — I spot a folded note on my desk.*

morning2_note_2.name: {name}
morning2_note_2.text: *'Come to the library annex at lunch. — Yuna'*

morning2_note_3.name: {name}
morning2_note_3.text: *The same handwriting as yesterday. A location is written at the bottom: 'Library annex.'*

morning2_seo_1.name: Seoyeon
morning2_seo_1.text: *She looks into the classroom as she passes in the hall.* Sleep well last night?

morning2_seo_4.name: {name}
morning2_seo_4.text: The council president walks all the way to the classroom just to say hi?

morning2_seo_5.name: Seoyeon
morning2_seo_5.text: I was on my way to the staff room. Thought I’d stop by and see you.

morning2_minsu_1.name: Seoyeon
morning2_minsu_1.text: I've seen you, so I'm going. ...Don't be late for homeroom. It would be awkward if checking on you made me late. *Before she leaves, her clipboard taps the doorframe once.*

morning2_minsu_1b.name: {name}
morning2_minsu_1b.text: *As I watch the hall where Seoyeon left, Minsu turns around.*

morning2_minsu_3.name: Minsu
morning2_minsu_3.text: Dude. Two days in and the council president comes to say hi to YOU? I've been here a year and she won't even look my way.

morning2_dain_claim_2.name: Minsu
morning2_dain_claim_2.text: That's true, but that's not the point.

morning2_dain_claim_3.name: {name}
morning2_dain_claim_3.text: *Seoyeon hugs the clipboard and heads down the hall.*

morning2_dain_claim_4.name: Dain
morning2_dain_claim_4.text: Even the student council president's interested in our transfer kid? Someone's popular!

morning2_dain_claim_6.name: Dain
morning2_dain_claim_6.text: We sit next to each other in class. That’s the least you can do.

morning2_break_transition.name: {name}
morning2_break_transition.text: *During break, I step out into the hall.*

morning2_break_transition_b.name: {name}
morning2_break_transition_b.text: *At the door, I meet the teacher's eyes over her attendance book.*

morning2_break_1.name: {name}
morning2_break_1.text: *The clipboard taps the desk. Seoyeon leaves before I can answer.*

hidden_homeroom_d2_1.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d2_1.text: Oh, {name}. Come to the faculty office for a sec.

hidden_homeroom_d2_1_c.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d2_1_c.text: No, just checking your transfer paperwork. — Administrative stuff.

hidden_homeroom_d2_2.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d2_2.text: *The corner of my transfer paperwork shows between the pages of her attendance book.*

hidden_homeroom_d2_2_b.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d2_2_b.text: *Manuscript paper shows in a staffroom drawer.* Should I sit here?

hidden_homeroom_d2_3.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d2_3.text: Looked at your old transcript. Your literature grades were solid. You into reading?

hidden_homeroom_d2_3_c.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d2_3_c.text: I didn’t expect to talk about novels, too. I thought you were just checking my Korean grades. *She lays a pen across the manuscript paper in the open drawer.*

hidden_homeroom_d2_3_d.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d2_3_d.text: You like reading. What about writing?

hidden_homeroom_d2_3_e.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d2_3_e.text: *The finger resting on the report card covers the corner of the manuscript paper.*

hidden_homeroom_d2_3_g.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d2_3_g.text: Hold on, the drawer is caught. *She stops pushing it with her knee; the corner of the manuscript paper is in the way.*

hidden_homeroom_d2_choice1.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d2_choice1.text: *My homeroom teacher stops trying to close the drawer and waits for my answer.*
choices: What about you? What do you read?
You only read difficult books, right?

hidden_homeroom_d2_choice1_a.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d2_choice1_a.text: Mystery novels. Not the kind about catching the culprit—the kind that traces the motive.

hidden_homeroom_d2_choice1_b.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d2_choice1_b.text: *She turns the coffee-cup handle in a full circle.* Really? That's a good hobby.

hidden_homeroom_d2_6.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d2_6.text: My desk's a bit of a mess, isn't it? *She tucks the manuscript away and closes the drawer.*

hidden_homeroom_d2_7.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d2_7.text: How's the adjustment? Better than yesterday?

hidden_homeroom_d2_7_b.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d2_7_b.text: A lot better. I like the people in my class.

hidden_homeroom_d2_8.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d2_8.text: Dain's loud, isn't she? — She's always like that. But there's a difference between a kid making trouble and a kid with too much energy.

hidden_homeroom_d2_8_b.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d2_8_b.text: Dain must be pretty well-known if you know her that well.

hidden_homeroom_d2_8_c.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d2_8_c.text: It's less that she's well-known and more that I worry about her. *She takes a sip of coffee.*

hidden_homeroom_d2_8_d.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d2_8_d.text: *The tip of her pen stops beside Dain's name in the attendance book.*

hidden_homeroom_d2_8_e.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d2_8_e.text: *She sets down her coffee.* Anyway, there don't seem to be any problems with you.

hidden_homeroom_d2_10.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d2_10.text: It’s part of being your homeroom teacher. You don’t need to be so formal.

hidden_homeroom_d2_choice2.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d2_choice2.text: *She turns the saucer twice in the same spot.*
choices: For 'just work,' you look pretty happy about it.
Thanks for looking out for me.
Is checking on me like this part of your job, too?

hidden_homeroom_d2_choice2_trap.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d2_choice2_trap.text: *Her hand stops turning the saucer.* Don't read into it like that.

hidden_homeroom_d2_choice2_a.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d2_choice2_a.text: Of course I’m glad to hear you’re doing well.

hidden_homeroom_d2_choice2_b.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d2_choice2_b.text: Well, thank you for saying so.

hidden_homeroom_d2_11.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d2_11.text: The others come to me when something’s troubling them, too. You’re welcome to do the same.

hidden_homeroom_d2_11_b.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d2_11_b.text: You don't need to feel bad about coming here. You don't have to tell me anything you don't want to. *She speaks softly, looking down at her coffee.*

morning2_seo_dust_1.name: Seoyeon
morning2_seo_dust_1.text: What have you been doing in first period? *In the hall at break, she looks at my shoulder.*

morning2_seo_dust_3.name: Seoyeon
morning2_seo_dust_3.text: *Her hand lands on {name}'s shoulder. She brushes the dust twice and takes it away.*

morning2_seo_dust_5.name: {name}
morning2_seo_dust_5.text: You startled me, reaching over like that. *I adjust my bag strap.*

morning2_dain_react_1.name: {name}
morning2_dain_react_1.text: *The dust is gone from my shoulder, but I readjust my bag strap twice.*

morning2_dain_react_2.name: {name}
morning2_dain_react_2.text: *Seoyeon adjusts her clipboard and heads down the hall. Dain's voice comes from behind.*

morning2_dain_react_3.name: Dain
morning2_dain_react_3.text: Hey, what was that? Did she just touch your shoulder?

morning2_dain_react_5.name: Dain
morning2_dain_react_5.text: Was there really dust on me?

morning2_dain_react_6.name: {name}
morning2_dain_react_6.text: She just brushed some dust off. Why are you looking at me like that? *I let go of the strap.*

hidden_homeroom_d2_freetalk.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d2_freetalk.text: *She turns her chair toward me.* Anything else you wanted to ask?
hidden_homeroom_d2_freetalk.context: It is the morning of Day 2, just after a counseling meeting in the faculty office. The transfer student happened to glimpse a long manuscript in the homeroom teacher's drawer but does not yet know its contents or history. They are a teacher and student beginning to build trust. Do not invent the manuscript's secret or cross the teacher-student boundary.
hidden_homeroom_d2_freetalk.personality: The homeroom teacher is calm, responsible, and listens before she advises. Her embarrassment about the personal manuscript appears in a brief hesitation, but she does not place emotional responsibility on the student and keeps a warm, appropriate boundary.

morning2_end.name: {name}
morning2_end.text: *According to Minsu, Seoyeon hasn't greeted anyone first in a whole year. Today, she came all the way to my classroom.*

hidden_homeroom_d2_choice1_trap.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d2_choice1_trap.text: Being a teacher doesn't mean I have to like difficult books.

morning2_greet_none_1.name: {name}
morning2_greet_none_1.text: *I open the classroom door. No one comes over. All I hear is a bag being put down.*

morning2_greet_none_2.name: {name}
morning2_greet_none_2.text: *Seoyeon turns a page in her attendance book. Dain turns toward her friends; Yuna already has her book open.*

morning2_greet_none_neg_1.name: {name}
morning2_greet_none_neg_1.text: *I open the classroom door. Eyes turn toward me, then look away at once. The sound of a bag being put down seems unusually loud.*

morning2_greet_none_neg_2.name: {name}
morning2_greet_none_neg_2.text: *None of the three looks my way.*

morning2_greet_dain_1_fun.name: Dain
morning2_greet_dain_1_fun.text: Hey! Yesterday was fun, let's hang again today!

morning2_greet_dain_1_plain.name: Dain
morning2_greet_dain_1_plain.text: Hey! Morning. Save some energy for today.

morning2_greet_yuna_1_thanks.name: Yuna
morning2_greet_yuna_1_thanks.text: *A folded note on the desk as I go to sit.* Thanks for yesterday.
